title: Cloud in a Bottle: Self-Host Web Apps on Your Own Server
description:
Cloud in a Bottle is a free, open-source platform that lets you deploy and share web apps on a server you control. Install apps from Git repos through a simple dashboard, and keep your data private. It's like your own private Heroku.
